item.description: When you write a question on the canvas and point at part of an AI reply with an arrow (straight, curved, dashed or drawn in pieces, either way round), an underline, a highlight or a circle, Margin now reads only your words as the question, shows the AI the reply itself with your marks drawn over it, and names the words you marked. A follow-up written beside an answer, or pointed at it, continues that answer and keeps what you highlighted before. Asking again about the whole of a question you first asked only part of no longer builds on the earlier misread answer. Includes everything in build 191.
